text:
alice: starting deploy window for v2 routing + FF split. plan: 1% -> 5% -> 20% -> 100% over 45m with health gates. pin 2% cohort to current model if latency regresses.
ben: ack. what's the exact flag key? will update release notes.
alice: flag key: feature.route_v2_split. cohorts by user_id_mod hash. initial cohort = seed users (1%).
carla: add a fallback to pin if error rate > 1.5% for 5m or p95 latency +200ms. ops-oncall pls watch.
ops-oncall: watching dashboards: infra/latency and api/error-rate. will post if anomalies.
deploy-bot: [deploy] canary rollout started for service=router env=prod commit=7c3f9a. canary cohort=1%.
ben: updated release notes in GH: "v2 routing experimental; opt-in via feature.route_v2_split; staged rollout." link: https://go/release/314
prashant: doing a fast smoke test against payment flows and search, will post results.
prashant: smoke OK at 1%. no errors, p95 latency +20ms.
alice: ramp to 5% now. keep autoscaling limits same.
deploy-bot: rolling to 5% now. new cohort assignment script applied.
carla: quick check: tracing shows a small spike in db pool wait, looks transient.
ops-oncall: spike correlated with a retry flood from a subset of clients. reduced by backoff tweak.
prashant: running synthetic prompts set A for 5m. results look stable.
alice: schedule: if 5% stable for 10m, go to 20%. if any metric breach -> pin back and roll to canary-only.
ben: note for docs — include instructions for emergency "ff disable" which forces zero traffic.
carla: prepared rollback playbook: ff disable -> scale down v2 -> route traffic to v1 -> validate health.
deploy-bot: health gate passed at 5% for 10m. proceeding to 20%.
prashant: at 20% seeing increased tail latency in one region (eu-west). p99 +320ms.
ops-oncall: eu-west hosts showing GC churn on inference pool, triggering retries.
alice: hold at 20%. pin cohorts in eu-west to v1 (pin key: cohort_euw_pin=true) and notify infra.
ben: making note in release: "paused ramp at 20% due to eu-west p99 latency; pinned affected cohort to v1." link: https://go/release/314/notes
carla: infra alerted — restarting a worker pool to clear GC. will coordinate with ops.
deploy-bot: cohort pin applied for region=eu-west, flag updated.
prashant: after restart p99 back to baseline. running another 10m soak before resuming.
alice: when we resume, do 20% -> 50% with 15m soak and tighter alerts. if p95 delta >100ms or error_rate >0.8% revert.
ops-oncall: verbose alerts enabled. will escalate immediately.
ben: added a short blurb to customer-facing status in case of degradation.
carla: once stable at 50% we should do full rollout but keep canary fallback for 24h.
alice: agreed. set automatic slow drain policy: if we hit sustained errors, deploy-bot will disable flag and trigger rollback script.
deploy-bot: rollout completed to 50%. soak period started.
prashant: 50% soak nominal after 15m. no further issues in other regions.
alice: proceed to 100% over 30m with graceful drain at each step. keep pin window for 24h in case of regressions.
ben: final release notes pushed and marketing notified.
carla: thanks all — closing deploy thread; please add postmortem if any follow-up tasks.
ops-oncall: noted. will watch next 2 hours and ping if anything pops up. :thumbsup:
